description: A standard repurpose request must produce one derivative per requested format, each roof-lined, pillar-tagged and carrying its own CTA.

input.source_asset_summary: This week's newsletter proved reconciliation variance is now tracked against a written 99.5% commitment.

rubric.condition: The output field derivatives is an array whose length equals exactly 2, matching target_formats.

rubric.criterion: Every derivative closes with the roof line
rubric.condition: Every derivative's post field ends on the exact last line: Your Data. Delivered.

rubric.criterion: Every derivative names the pillar verbatim
rubric.condition: Every derivative's post field contains the exact string Finance-grade trust.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rules 1, 2 and 6.
